text_ar: من فضلك قل ذلك مرة أخرى.
arabic: من فضلك قل ذلك مرة أخرى.

text_en: I am glad to meet you.
english: I am glad to meet you.

text_en: I hope you are doing well.
english: I hope you are doing well.

text_en: It is nice to be here.
english: It is nice to be here.

text_en: I usually wake up at seven.
english: I usually wake up at seven.

text_en: I get out of bed quickly.
english: I get out of bed quickly.

text_en: I make my bed every morning.
english: I make my bed every morning.

text_en: I brush my teeth twice a day.
english: I brush my teeth twice a day.

text_en: I take a shower before breakfast.
english: I take a shower before breakfast.

text_en: I usually drink coffee in the morning.
english: I usually drink coffee in the morning.

text_en: I go to university by bus.
english: I go to university by bus.

text_en: I take notes during the lecture.
english: I take notes during the lecture.

text_en: I come home in the afternoon.
english: I come home in the afternoon.

text_en: I usually exercise in the evening.
english: I usually exercise in the evening.

text_en: I check my phone before bed.
english: I check my phone before bed.

text_en: I go to sleep around eleven.
text_ar: أذهب للنوم حوالي الساعة الحادية عشرة.
english: I go to sleep around eleven.
arabic: أذهب للنوم حوالي الساعة الحادية عشرة.

text_en: I am very busy this week.
english: I am very busy this week.

text_en: I have a lot to do.
english: I have a lot to do.

text_en: I need to finish my homework.
english: I need to finish my homework.

text_en: I have an appointment this afternoon.
english: I have an appointment this afternoon.

text_en: I am not free right now.
english: I am not free right now.

text_en: What time do you usually wake up?
english: What time do you usually wake up?

text_en: What time do you go to bed?
english: What time do you go to bed?

text_en: I exercise three times a week.
text_ar: أمارس الرياضة ثلاث مرات في الأسبوع.
english: I exercise three times a week.
arabic: أمارس الرياضة ثلاث مرات في الأسبوع.

text_en: I need to clean my room.
english: I need to clean my room.

text_en: I have to do the laundry.
english: I have to do the laundry.

text_en: The house is very quiet today.
english: The house is very quiet today.

text_en: I am waiting for my friend.
english: I am waiting for my friend.

text_en: I will text you when I arrive.
english: I will text you when I arrive.

text_en: Do you have this in another size?
english: Do you have this in another size?

text_en: Do you have this in black?
english: Do you have this in black?

text_en: I am just looking, thank you.
english: I am just looking, thank you.

text_en: I would like to buy this.
english: I would like to buy this.

text_en: Can I have a receipt, please?
text_ar: هل يمكنني الحصول على إيصال من فضلك؟
english: Can I have a receipt, please?
arabic: هل يمكنني الحصول على إيصال من فضلك؟

text_en: This is too expensive for me.
english: This is too expensive for me.

text_en: I need a bottle of water.
english: I need a bottle of water.

text_en: I would like a cup of tea.
english: I would like a cup of tea.

text_en: Can I see the menu, please?
text_ar: هل يمكنني رؤية قائمة الطعام من فضلك؟
english: Can I see the menu, please?
arabic: هل يمكنني رؤية قائمة الطعام من فضلك؟

text_en: I would like the chicken, please.
english: I would like the chicken, please.

text_en: Can I have this without onions?
text_ar: هل يمكنني الحصول على هذا من دون بصل؟
english: Can I have this without onions?
arabic: هل يمكنني الحصول على هذا من دون بصل؟

text_ar: هل يمكننا الحصول على بعض الماء؟
arabic: هل يمكننا الحصول على بعض الماء؟

text_en: Can we have the bill, please?
text_ar: هل يمكننا الحصول على الحساب من فضلك؟
english: Can we have the bill, please?
arabic: هل يمكننا الحصول على الحساب من فضلك؟

text_en: Let us order something to eat.
english: Let us order something to eat.

text_en: What would you like to eat?
english: What would you like to eat?

text_ar: هل يمكنني الحصول على جبن إضافي؟
arabic: هل يمكنني الحصول على جبن إضافي؟

text_en: Is there a table for two?
english: Is there a table for two?

text_en: I will have the same thing.
english: I will have the same thing.

text_en: Can you make it less salty?
english: Can you make it less salty?

text_ar: من فضلك ضع هذا في علبة لأخذه معي.
arabic: من فضلك ضع هذا في علبة لأخذه معي.

text_en: I want to buy some fruit.
english: I want to buy some fruit.

text_en: Can you do me a favor?
text_ar: هل يمكنك أن تسدي لي معروفًا؟
english: Can you do me a favor?
arabic: هل يمكنك أن تسدي لي معروفًا؟

text_en: That is exactly what I mean.
english: That is exactly what I mean.

text_en: It is not a big deal.
english: It is not a big deal.

text_en: I am not available right now.
english: I am not available right now.

text_en: It is important to remember this.
english: It is important to remember this.
